predicate_sql: bdc_dimensions_raw LIKE '%Commitment Type%' AND (TRY_CAST(fair_value AS DOUBLE) <= 0 OR TRY_CAST(cost AS DOUBLE) = TRY_CAST(fair_value AS DOUBLE))

evidence.quote: Holdings commitment rows selected by predicate sum to -1327000 for 2024-12-31, -1243000 for 2025-03-31, -1122000 for 2025-09-30, and -1481000 for 2025-12-31.
Applying this commitment exclusion with the liquidity-label fixes gives residual_after 0 for 2024-12-31, 0 for 2025-03-31, about -7000 for 2025-09-30, and 0 for 2025-12-31.

rationale: Rows identified only as Commitment Type are unfunded commitment fair-value marks, not schedule investments counted in the investments-at-fair-value anchor. Including negative and cost-equals-fair-value commitment marks depresses the conservation sum; excluding them aligns the schedule with the fund-financials investment anchor without deleting operating investment positions.
